title: purple-mimi 3a: mimid groundwork for the embedded plugin
description: In mimid (Apache-2.0), for purple-mimi (docs/design/purple-mimi.md §13 step 3a): a typed error for a 404 at the live-stream upgrade (§7.1); Agent::open compares ProviderHello userUri with the configured user (§7.2); Store::decline_invite (§8.11); the state lock (flock on <state>/lock, inode check) in mimid-agent-core StateDir if Mark agrees (§6.2, §14 q2); an explicit close that ends the stream tasks (§6.4); the daemon's sync, expiry and KeyPackage loops moved into mimid-agent-store as a runner the daemon uses (§5.1); acceptance_fixture --providers-only printing provider URLs and provider tokens (§11); AGENTS.md mimid-agent row: embedders hold keys too (§12.1); a tagged revision. About 800 to 1,200 lines with tests (estimate). Waits for Mark's review of the design.
